distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) record Sichuan; Smith et al. (2020) confirms Sichuan. Lin & Smith (2022) reports China and a new Taiwan record; Taiwan is therefore added as Present. No additional mainland province is inferred from the broad China wording.

host_note: Smith et al. (2020) provides genus-level Carpinus, Illicium, Cleyera and Eurya. Lin & Smith (2022) adds the source-supported host names Carpinus laxiflora, Clyera spp., Eurya japonica, Illicium religiosum and Ilex rotunda. Source spellings are retained without silent correction.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xyleborinus octiesdentatus (Murayama, 1931).
